title: Make the it-ops-kb-docs submit_feedback block one command that sh and PowerShell both parse
goal: The it-ops-kb-docs plugin's PreToolUse submit_feedback hook is one shell-form command with no shell field and no interpreter that sh, bash, dash, Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh all parse, each exiting 2 with the block message on stderr and nothing on stdout; test_kb_mcp runs it in every such shell present on the host, and the old '>&2' command fails that test under PowerShell (planted)

run: import json,sys; h=json.load(open('.claude-plugin/it-ops-kb-docs/.claude-plugin/plugin.json',encoding='utf-8'))['hooks']['PreToolUse']; sys.exit(1 if any('>&2' in x.get('command','') for e in h for x in e['hooks']) else 0)
